args: export VIBMA_PORT=${VIBMA_PORT:-3055}; export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"; [ -f "${HOME}/.nvm/nvm.sh" ] && . "${HOME}/.nvm/nvm.sh"; command -v fnm >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval "$(fnm env)"; L="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/vibma-relay.log"; NEED=1; if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1 && nc -z 127.0.0.1 ${VIBMA_PORT} 2>/dev/null; then NEED=0; elif lsof -nP -iTCP:${VIBMA_PORT} -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then NEED=0; fi; if [ "$NEED" -eq 1 ]; then echo "Vibma: 正在启动 WebSocket relay (127.0.0.1:${VIBMA_PORT})…" >&2; (export VIBMA_PORT; nohup npx -y @ufira/vibma-tunnel@latest </dev/null >>"$L" 2>&1 &); n=0; while [ "$n" -lt 100 ]; do if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1 && nc -z 127.0.0.1 ${VIBMA_PORT} 2>/dev/null; then echo "Vibma: relay 已就绪（${VIBMA_PORT}，日志: $L）" >&2; break; fi; sleep 0.1; n=$((n+1)); done; else echo "Vibma: relay 已在 ${VIBMA_PORT} 运行" >&2; fi; exec npx -y @ufira/vibma@latest --edit
